question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pull yourself together
solution:
The correct answer is "**Calm down**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The idiom "pull yourself together" means to calm down and regain control of your emotions or behavior.**
 
• शांत होने और अपनी भावनाओं या व्यवहार पर नियंत्रण पाने के लिए।
 
• It is often used when someone is upset, panicking, or acting erratically.
 
• The phrase can be used as a command or suggestion to the person who needs to calm down.
 
 
• Example: After hearing the bad news I needed a few minutes to pull myself together.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that option 4 correctly explains the meaning of the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
